components.text:
The Ritual of the Green Grove acts as an automatic fertilizer, periodically bonemealing crops and plants within its range to speed up their growth. Tier 0, costs $(blood)5,000 LP$() to activate.
Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.

Various Demon Will types can be channeled into this ritual via the Aura to change its behavior - for example granting hydration or leeching health from nearby entities to speed growth further. Check the ritual's tooltip in-game (via the Ritual Diviner or a Divination Sigil) for the exact current bonuses on this branch.
